exposure: Standardised criteria for trial of scar
cohort: Women who gave birth between 2000 and 2018 at a tertiary centre in South India
finding: A policy of rigorous audits of stillbirths and birth asphyxia, electronic fetal monitoring, and the introduction of standardised criteria for trial of scar, reduced the perinatal mortality and the rate of babies born with birth asphyxia over the past 18 years, without an increase in the caesarean section rate.
